Dispersed or compact cross-attribute class.

definition: Agent number evaluated at one binary-search-style step.
Whether the tested value satisfied the configured criterion.
Program classification for a failed test.

definition: Elapsed computation time when the solver halted.
missing_value_interpretation: Blank only if the record itself lacks time.

definition: Conflicts detected when computation halted.
missing_value_interpretation: Blank when unavailable; never assume zero.

definition: Sum of all agent path lengths.
Number of records summarized in the mapping/capacity group.
missing_value_interpretation: Zero means no records were available.

definition: Number of successful records in the group.
Number of runtime-limited unfinished records in the group.
Number of solved runs contributing to path statistics.
missing_value_interpretation: Zero means no valid path values.

definition: Arithmetic mean halted time across available group records.
missing_value_interpretation: Blank when no time values exist.

definition: Arithmetic mean conflicts at halt across available group records.
missing_value_interpretation: Blank when no conflict values exist.

definition: Arithmetic mean total path length across solved records only.
missing_value_interpretation: Blank when no solved path values exist.

definition: Whether both mappings were matched by run_config_id.
missing_value_interpretation: Incomplete pair means one side is missing.

definition: Paired cyclic time percentage change relative to classical.
missing_value_interpretation: Blank when classical time is zero/unavailable.

definition: Paired cyclic conflicts percentage change relative to classical.
missing_value_interpretation: Blank when classical conflicts are zero/unavailable.

definition: Paired cyclic path-length percentage change relative to classical.
missing_value_interpretation: Blank unless both runs solved and classical path is nonzero.

definition: Mapping with lower mean halted time in the capacity context.
missing_value_interpretation: Unavailable when either mean is missing.

definition: Mapping with lower mean conflicts in the capacity context.
missing_value_interpretation: Unavailable when either mean is missing.

definition: Whether cyclic mean total path length is longer, shorter, same, or unavailable.
missing_value_interpretation: Unavailable when either path mean is missing.
